sloka: सौमित्रे पश्य पम्पाया दक्षिणे गिरि सानुषु ।पुष्पितान् कर्णिकारस्य यष्टिम् परम शोभिताम् ॥४-१-७३॥
transliteration: saumitre paśya pampāyā dakṣiṇe giri sānuṣu ।puṣpitān karṇikārasya yaṣṭim parama śobhitām ॥4-1-73॥

translations.english: 'This king of mountains is rich with plenty of minerals and, therefore, generates multicoloured dust particles splattered by the speed of the wind.
